title: Hypovolemic Shock Pathophysiology of Disease
author: Doyouseewhy7
caption: Pathophysiology diagram of hypovolemic shock illustrating intravascular volume depletion, decreased venous return, reduced cardiac output, and compensatory vasoconstriction.
alt_text: Flowchart diagram showing hemodynamic cascade from blood or fluid loss to decreased preload, reduced stroke volume, and tissue hypoperfusion.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates the hemodynamic decompensation cascade in traumatic hypovolemic shock (CLIFF-016, p.1).
